design: Three-group cross-sectional (Normal vs CIN3 vs SCC); no paired-sample structure
platform_caveat: GPL13534 HM450 — same platform as TCGA-PAAD/CESC/LIHC. Xu-538 panel coverage expected to be ≥98% per prior cohorts.
n_caveats: n=4 SCC arm limits Normal-vs-SCC and CIN3-vs-SCC CI precision. Primary statistical anchor is Normal-vs-CIN3 (n=28+36=64) and Normal-vs-lesion-pooled (n=28+40=68).
